name: Dual Contouring with SDF constraints
definition: Each row of $Q_d$ stores $\alpha \cdot \mathbf{d}^T$, where $\alpha$ is the barycentric coordinate of $\mathbf{t}_j^r$ with respect to $\mathbf{x}^r$.
summary: Dual Contouring with SDF constraints extracts quad meshes from Signed Distance Function data by replacing global geometric flow with local quadratic programming that explicitly incorporates SDF constraints for higher fidelity.
